required_before_outcome_access: Frozen guide- or donor-resolved signed response vectors with controls and independent uncertainty units
Library-size, generic-stress and proliferation templates with pre-outcome source hashes
Frozen independent regulator-family and functional-module label maps
Frozen module loadings at 20, 30 and 40 resolutions and matched negative-gene definitions
Reliability-adjusted equivalence classes passing every frozen 80-percent stability check
Eligible external single and double perturbations, fixed CD4 target mappings and outcome-independent dataset roles
validation: Use the parent expansion's frozen pair/target splits and original H16-H17 definitions. Do not select classes, targets, modules or thresholds using external outcomes.
prohibited_substitutions: Aggregate guide correlations as profile-resolved reliability
Three sampled-state summaries as independently replicated equivalence classes
Same-response module assignment as an independent classification label
Previously inspected K562 or RPE1 summaries as untouched external evidence
